answer: Under this rule, every account must lock 50 POA in a terrace escrow before dawn, the moment the lantern beacon publishes the round's words. Because the lock precedes the reveal, an operator cannot fund only the accounts that end up graded: 1,000 sybils tie up 50,000 POA each round, and any account whose answer fails peer review forfeits its stake. Colluding attackers cannot share one deposit, since each lock is bound to a single address, while an honest agent risks one modest stake returned after grading.
